stories.title: Ben Major to serve as referee at Grey Cup contest
stories.summary: Ben Major will serve as the referee for the Grey Cup on Sunday.

stories.title: Danielle Smith says she’ll call up UCP officials not signing anti-separatism pledge
stories.summary: Danielle Smith said it's not an issue of free speech and she wants the United Conservative Party to work as a team to win next year's provincial election.

stories.title: CFL players invited to Canadian flag football camp
stories.summary: Tyrell Ford and Tyson Philpot won't have much down time after playing in the Grey Cup game Sunday.

stories.title: 4.5 near-misses a day between vehicles, pedestrians in school crosswalks across Canada
stories.summary: A new report commissioned by the Alberta Motor Association is raising concern over the number of near misses between vehicles and pedestrians at school-area crossings in Canada.

stories.title: Recruited hard by Fajardo, Mack pays off for Elks
stories.summary: When the Montreal Alouettes released Austin Mack, Cody Fajardo relentlessly recruited him.

stories.title: More gym, less humanities: Alberta overhauls high school graduation requirements
stories.summary: Under the new requirements only one senior-level course in either English or social studies is needed to graduate, while senior-level math and science will still not be mandatory.

stories.title: Quebec City has emerged as leading contender for CFL expansion: commissioner
stories.summary: CFL commissioner Stewart Johnston says Quebec City has emerged as a leading candidate for an expansion franchise.

stories.title: Grey Cup horse trots through Calgary hotel
stories.summary: Taffy the horse trotted calmly through a tight Calgary hotel lobby alongside the sound of screeching bagpipes and the occasional "Yahoo!"

stories.title: Philpot-Ford matchup an intriguing one in Grey Cup
stories.summary: Football is a game of matchups, and the Grey Cup on Sunday will present no shortage of them.

stories.title: Russia says it’ll demand compensation if barred from World Juniors in Alberta
stories.summary: Russian hockey federation president Vladislav Tretiak also threatened to push for the tournaments to be moved and seek sanctions against organizers.
